newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher in all months.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures market closed higher across the board on Friday, as the weaker yen encouraged local investors to buy, but trading was thin due to Japan's "Golden Week" holidays, traders said.
Prices were 0.6 to 1.3 yen higher, with the benchmark October 1997 contract up 0.8 yen at 141.5 yen per tonne.

Some months opened weaker on light technical selling from local investors, traders said. By late morning, the yen's weaker tone against the dollar encouraged investors to buy, they said. The market will be closed on Monday due to a national holiday. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-7391
